items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: And this Russell Smith, he was a good showman and all like that, but he was no good in a dance band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, these fellows -- we used to call them -- there were three of them. And all of them came -- originally there was six of them, they came from out West someplace. But three of them got to New York. And this Russell Smith, he was a good showman and all like that, but he was no good in a dance band.

He played the shows. He played in Lou Leslie's Blackbirds one year, and other shows. Then there was Luke. Luke, he was interested in pool. He was one of the best pool players. He could beat the world's best pool shark, too. But he was a good trumpet player. But he wasn't interested in music. Then there was Joe Smith.
